correctness.rationale: Theorem 6 of arXiv:2307.05168 gives exact avoidance of Hamming-distance-two pairs. Parity splits Q8 into two independent 128-vertex halved cubes. The C++17 source exhaustively enumerates anchored independent sets of sizes 5-8, with candidate counts 611100, 2984625, 7490595, 9234285 and respective dominating counts 0,0,0,142380; sizes <=4 fail the 128/29 neighborhood lower bound. Zero-anchored code census transfers by even-XOR transitivity: 128*142380/8=2278080 per component; squaring yields 5189648486400. The independent Python BFS checks the explicit 16-point witness and all cube vertex pairs. Finite exact result, no extrapolation.
